description: This file is a React component implementing the client-side logic for handling OAuth callback redirects from various providers (e.g., GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket). It manages parsing URL parameters, calling backend APIs to complete OAuth flow, and displaying status messages based on success or failure.

methods.name: isProvider
methods.description: Type guard function to validate if a given string is a supported OAuth provider.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackClient
methods.description: React component that handles OAuth callback logic, including parsing URL parameters, calling backend API to finalize OAuth process, and rendering status messages.
